# Unpaste.ai

> Unpaste.ai is a Brisbane AI training company. Elliot Stone teaches business owners and teams to run their work with Claude, Claude Code and Cowork, through hands-on workshops, team dev days and 1:1 coaching.

Not the toothpaste brand. Unpaste.ai (unpaste.ai, Brisbane, Australia, founded 2025) trains people who do not write code to run their business with AI agents. Contact: elliot@unpaste.co. LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/in/elliot-stone-66a5a1a4

## What we run

- [Claude Code training](https://unpaste.ai/claude-code-training): Hands-on Claude Code training for business owners and teams, Brisbane and online. Three formats, no code needed.
- [Brisbane workshop](https://unpaste.ai/workshops): One day, small group, bring your laptop. Leave using Claude Code on your own work. $399 + GST a seat.
- [Team dev day](https://unpaste.ai/coaching): One day at your office, $3,500. Your team's AI workspace set up and everyone trained on it.
- [1:1 AI upskilling](https://unpaste.ai/coaching): Eight weeks, four sessions, on your business, $2,000. In person in Brisbane or remote.
- [Training overview](https://unpaste.ai/training): How the formats fit together and what you own at the end.
- [Claude & Coffee](https://unpaste.ai/claude-and-coffee): Free weekly meetup, every Tuesday 7 to 8:30am, Jagger Rocky Studios, Coorparoo. See AI agents doing real work, ask anything.

## Free resources

- [Efficiency Score assessment](https://unpaste.ai/assessment): 15 questions, 5 minutes, shows where the hours go.
- [Quick wins by industry](https://unpaste.ai/quick-wins): Five practical AI workflows each for real estate, mortgage broking, financial advice, trades and distribution.
- [Prompts and starter pack](https://unpaste.ai/resources): Claude Code starter files and taste files.
- [Brand guide template](https://unpaste.ai/brand/template): The Unpaste brand guide as a reusable template.
